refnamediv.refpurpose: Freeze a player so they cannot move, shoot, or interact.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: freeze freezes a player in place. Frozen players cannot move, shoot, or interact. An optional TIME parameter sets the duration (e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h). If no time is specified, the player remains frozen until manually unfrozen.
